name: Akuyaku Reijou wa Mendere Ouji ni Ecchi na Goumon Sareru Nante Bug Desu ka
original_name: 悪役令嬢はメンデレ王子にＨな拷問されるなんてバグですか
source:
"If only I had never known love."

This place is a game world! And to make matters worse, I'm the villainess!?

"Espionage is punishable by death. Choose execution, or choose marriage to me... Truly a simple dilemma, wouldn't you agree?"

Captured by a prince who was supposed to be a side character, subjected to erotic interrogation!?

A yandere nightmare orchestrated by a troublesome, mentally unstable prince.

Only the finest Happy End awaits. Everything else is a Bad End.

What cruel choices await you?

[Translated from [url=https://www.forbidden-apple.info/menge]Official website[/url]]
translation:
“如果我从来不知道爱就好了。”

这里是一个游戏世界！更糟糕的是，我还是恶棍！？

“间谍罪是死刑。选择处决，还是选择嫁给我……真是一个简单的两难选择，你同意吗？”

被本应是配角的王子抓住，接受色情审讯！？

一场由麻烦缠身、精神不稳定的王子精心策划的病态噩梦。

只有最好的快乐结局在等待着。其他一切都是Bad End。

什么样的残酷选择等待着你？

[翻译自[url=https://www.forbidden-apple.info/menge]官网[/url]]
